Author: Infi, Sl0nderman, harbingerftw
Name: Blue Mage & Beastmaster Helper
Description: Adds a window to show all Blue Magic and Beastmaster Pets, letting you search for them with links to teleport or mark the location or open the Duty Finder. Also adds headmarkers to the mobs you still need..
Punchline: Helps fill out your Blue Mage Spellbook & Beastmaster Beastiary!
